parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Specify the region based on where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Assets are in regions outside China.

parameters.name: SourceLogCode
parameters.description: The code of the log to query.

parameters.name: SourceProdCode
parameters.description: The code of the product to query.

parameters.name: SubUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to query.
